00System overview

Every lead source runs into one agent. Nothing falls out of the system.

Your contact page tells patients to text or call Madison, and Ireon's review says he was amazed the therapist himself got back to him instead of a receptionist. That personal touch is the point, and it's also the bottleneck while you're one-on-one with a patient. The engine keeps it: new ad leads, past patients and every missed call land with one AI agent that replies in seconds, in Pinnacle's voice, and books the $49 Discovery Visit. Anyone who doesn't book, no-shows or finishes care gets recycled back into reactivation instead of forgotten.

Lead flow · live

04

Nothing leaks

02Funnel

Why ads go to a funnel, not your website

pinnacledpt.com is a good site and it should stay: condition pages for every body part, golf, TMJ, massage, blogs, videos and ebooks. That's perfect for someone researching. Someone who just clicked an ad needs one thing: a reason to book and an easy way to do it.

01

Only what matters

Just the information that gets someone to book: their problem, your approach, real reviews, what the visit covers and what it costs. Nothing else.

02

No distractions

No menu with 60 condition pages, no blog, no ebooks, no links away. Every extra page is a chance for them to wander off and forget about you.

03

One choice: book

Too many options causes decision paralysis. Every button on the page does the same thing: book the $49 Discovery Visit.

pinnacledpt.com/discovery-visit
  • Headline matches the ad they clicked
  • Six real patient reviews up front
  • What the visit covers, answered early
  • One action: the $49 Discovery Visit
03AI appointment agent

An agent that answers while you're one-on-one with a patient

The practice that replies first usually wins the patient, and you can't text back mid-session. This agent replies to every lead in seconds, answers questions from your own website, explains what the Discovery Visit covers, and books it.

  • Knows your services, specialties, team and hours
  • Never gives medical advice or invents details
  • Offers two open times and books the one they pick
  • Hands off to Madison or you whenever it should

LIVE · TRY ITAsk it anything a new patient would. It already knows Pinnacle's services from your website.

Pinnacle Physical Therapy
Patient coordinator · replies instantly
04Database reactivation

Turn the leads you already have into booked visits

Every past patient and every person who asked about care but never booked is already on your list. Regular email and SMS campaigns bring them back, at almost no cost per booking.

SMS campaign
SENDTo old leads and past patients, every few months
Hi Kevin, it's Madison at Pinnacle Physical Therapy. It's been a while since your last visit, how's the shoulder holding up? We opened a few $49 Discovery Visit spots this month if you want Dr. Murphy to take a look.
honestly its been creeping back. anything next week?
Email campaign
SENDMonthly, to the whole list
Pinnacle Physical TherapyStill dealing with that pain?
Hi Sarah, A while back you reached out about your low back. If it's still bothering you, we'd love to help. Every session at Pinnacle is one-on-one with your physical therapist, never a tech or an aide, and we look at your whole body to find the root cause, without medications, injections or surgery. Reply to this email or text us to book a $49 Discovery Visit. You'll leave knowing what's going on, whether PT can help, how long it should take and what it will cost. The Pinnacle Physical Therapy team

06The guarantee

7-10 paid assessments within your first 6 weeks, guaranteed.

Your site already sells a $49 Discovery Visit, so we're not changing your offer, just putting it in front of more of the right people in Little Rock and making sure every one of them gets an answer. Here's what we commit to.

01

We work until it's hit

If you get fewer than 7, we keep running your campaigns and you pay no booking fees until you've received them. No renegotiation.

02

Pay per booking, never a retainer

Our fees are waived for your first 6 weeks. After that you pay only for paid assessments, and you keep the $49 every patient pays.

03

Prepaid patients show up

Every patient pays when they book, so you get people who are serious, higher show rates and a payment record for every booking.
